title: Glowing football
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFAA" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#FFDD44" stop-opacity="0.4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFDD44" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="ball" cx="45%" cy="40%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#F0F0E8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D4D4C8"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow halo -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="46" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Ball body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="34" fill="url(#ball)" stroke="#E8E8B0" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Pentagon panels -->
  <!-- Center pentagon -->
  <polygon points="50,34 58,40 55,50 45,50 42,40" fill="#2A2A4A" stroke="#E8E8B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Top pentagon -->
  <polygon points="50,18 57,24 55,32 45,32 43,24" fill="#2A2A4A" stroke="#E8E8B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Left pentagon -->
  <polygon points="24,40 31,35 37,40 35,49 27,49" fill="#2A2A4A" stroke="#E8E8B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Right pentagon -->
  <polygon points="76,40 69,35 63,40 65,49 73,49" fill="#2A2A4A" stroke="#E8E8B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Bottom-left pentagon -->
  <polygon points="30,64 36,57 43,59 45,67 38,72" fill="#2A2A4A" stroke="#E8E8B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Bottom-right pentagon -->
  <polygon points="70,64 64,57 57,59 55,67 62,72" fill="#2A2A4A" stroke="#E8E8B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Bottom pentagon -->
  <polygon points="50,74 55,68 52,60 48,60 45,68" fill="#2A2A4A" stroke="#E8E8B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Connecting lines between pentagons -->
  <line x1="50" y1="34" x2="50" y2="32" stroke="#B8B84A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="40" x2="63" y2="40" stroke="#B8B84A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="40" x2="37" y2="40" stroke="#B8B84A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="50" x2="55" y2="59" stroke="#B8B84A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="50" x2="45" y2="59" stroke="#B8B84A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="27" y1="49" x2="35" y2="49" stroke="#B8B84A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="49" x2="73" y2="49" stroke="#B8B84A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="18" x2="55" y2="24" stroke="#B8B84A" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="40" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="38" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Light rays -->
  <g stroke="#FFEE66" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="50" y1="2" x2="50" y2="10"/>
    <line x1="85" y1="18" x2="79" y2="24"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="18" x2="21" y2="24"/>
    <line x1="92" y1="52" x2="84" y2="52"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="52" x2="16" y2="52"/>
  </g>
</svg>
